head: Spotify Artist Profile Protection now open to all artists against AI fakes
dek: Since 17 November every artist on Spotify can switch on Artist Profile Protection in Spotify for Artists and remove their name from releases that aren't theirs, such as AI fakes or songs by someone with the same name. Removed releases no longer show on the profile, count in its stats or get recommended to the artist's listeners.
details: The tool was in beta since March with thousands of artists. With the default setting, new music goes live as planned and the artist has up to 28 days after release to remove their name; an advanced Block setting, still tested with a limited group, holds releases until the artist approves them. Artists can give trusted distributors an artist key so their releases count as approved. Spotify says it removed more than 50 million spam tracks from recommendations this year.
where: All artists on Spotify, in Spotify for Artists, since 17 November
means: If you release music, you get a notice when a release lists your name and can take yourself off ones that aren't yours. If you just listen, fake songs under an artist's name should show up less on their page.
todo: Artists: on desktop, open the menu under your profile picture in Spotify for Artists and pick Artist Profile Protection; in the mobile app it's the Review tab on the Music page. Team Admins and Editors can set it up.
thumb_words: SPOTIFY LETS ARTISTS REMOVE AI FAKES
